Bytes is a lazy adapter over hidden reader state, and current vstd has no Read-to-Iterator abstraction relating its yielded results to the consumed reader.
The returned adapter's behavior depends on two hidden reader states and its private first-reader completion flag, none of which has a public vstd model.
Reader contents and advancement are unmodeled, and the source explicitly warns that safe callers cannot even rely on a custom implementation returning n no greater than buf.len().
Success fills the buffer from unmodeled reader state, while the source leaves buffer contents unspecified on error; existing vstd vocabulary provides no useful value relation.
